## Type Scale Generator 0.1.2

- Major update introducing Figma integration and enhanced typographic detail.
- Now supports generating full text styles: each scale step includes rounded size, calculated line-height, and tracking values.
- Can read font size and family directly from selected Figma text, and offers Figma variable and text style output (with user confirmation).
- Prompting and workflow improved: skill asks for only missing values, always displays the computed scale before writing anything, and summarizes all decisions/assumptions.
- Adds collision and rounding safeguards: prevents overlapping or collapsed steps after rounding, with guided fixes.
- Documentation expanded and clarified: new inputs and outputs, integration flow, and stricter out-of-scope boundaries.

- No code to functional features.
- "Schoger, A. (2018), Refactoring UI" → "Wathan, A., Schoger, S. (2018), Refactoring UI" (correct co-authors, real book by Adam Wathan & Steve Schoger).

- Initial release of type-scale-generator.
- Generates a full typographic scale (H1–H6, body, caption) from a base font size and a mathematical ratio or historical/fixed scale.
- Outputs results as CSS custom properties or Tailwind config, with raw and rounded values for auditability.
- Supports musical/geometric ratios, Fibonacci, and classic Garamond step tables; defaults to Minor Third (1.2) if unspecified.
- Applies smart rounding and enforces a 12px minimum for body text to ensure accessibility.
- Optionally outputs fluid type scales using clamp() and integrates with Figma for reading/writing text styles when enabled.
